# PriceWin for DeepSeek Harness

Live hotel and flight prices compared across Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com and
Traveloka, in USD, fro

m inside DeepSeek Harness.
This is a DSH plugin bundle; its `cordis.patch.yml` adds three entries to

Seek Harness.
This is a DSH plugin bundle; its `cordis.patch.yml` adds three entries to the
profile:

- **`pricewin-mcp`**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` connected to the PriceWin MCP
server, `https://m

cp.price.win/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no account, no API key);
- **`pricewin-skills`**: a `@deepseek-a

i/dsh-skill-filesystem` provider that
serves only this package's `skills/pricewin-travel-search`: ho

w to run a
search (results arrive in two steps), what to ask when the trip details are
incomplete, a

nd how to read prices and links;
- **`pricewin-dsh`**: this package's own plugin, which shows hotel

and flight
results as cards in the Web UI.
## Result cards

In the Web UI, hotel searches appear as cards with the hotel's photo, rating,
whole-stay price, nigh

tly price, and one chip per booking site, with the
cheapest marked. Flight searches list departure a

nd arrival times, airline,
duration and stops, and every site's fare. Every price links to the site

that
quoted it. Hotels that sell their own rooms through TravelOpen carry a
"Book direct · pay at th

e hotel" label. The model still receives the same text
results, and the cards cost no extra tokens.
The plugin has two halves, both plain JavaScript with no build step:

- `lib/index.js` runs in the harness. DSH's MCP bridge passes only the text of a
result to the brows

er, so this half adds a compact `presentationMeta` record
of the hotels or fares to the four search

tools (`search_hotels_live`,
`poll_search_results`, `search_flights_live`, `poll_flight_results`).
-

`lib/client.js` registers those four tool names in the `tool.call.toolview`
slot and draws the card

s. If a result has no such record, for example in a
session from before the plugin was installed, th

e card shows the result's
text.

Card labels follow the DSH interface language (Chinese or English), and prices
and dates are formatt
ed for the browser's locale.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or from GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Use the name of your profile in place of `web`. You can also add it from the
**Plugins** page in the
Web sidebar. Then ask, for example:
> Compare hotel prices in Da Nang for 2 adults from November 10 to 12.
The tools appear as `mcp__pricewin__<tool>`.

Tested with DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 (`dsh --profile web`, hotel and flight searches
through the Web UI, light

and dark themes). DSH is a preview and its
configuration format still changes; if a newer version r

efuses the bundle,
please open an issue.
## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
| `search_hotels_live`, `poll_search_results` | Search a city's hotels across the OTAs and OpenTrave

l partner hotels; results arrive in two steps |
| `search_flights_live`, `poll_flight_results` | Sea

rch one-way or per-leg round-trip fares |
| `get_ota_hotel_detail` | Rooms, live prices, facilities

and reviews for one named hotel (Booking.com) |
| `get_hotel_detail`, `get_hotel_info` | Rooms and p

rices, or facilities and policies, of an OpenTravel partner hotel |
| `get_cancellation_policy` | Re

fund terms for one rate |
| `request_booking`, `check_booking_status` | Send a booking request to a

partner hotel and read its status |
| `request_cancel_token`, `cancel_booking` | Cancel such a booki

read its status |
| `request_cancel_token`, `cancel_booking` | Cancel such a booking, in two steps |

**Booking takes no money.** `request_booking` sends the guest's name, phone and
email to the hotel,

which confirms the request; no room is held and the guest
pays at the property. Cancelling needs a s

ingle-use token that is emailed to the
address on the booking, so nothing is cancelled without the g

hat is emailed to the
address on the booking, so nothing is cancelled without the guest's own inbox.
## What the bundle sends, and where
DSH talks to one remote MCP server, `https://mcp.price.win/mcp`.

- **To `mcp.price.win`**: the arguments of each tool call, which are trip details
(city, dates, part

y size, hotel name, price range, airports, cabin), a short
excerpt of the request used only to pick

the reply language, and, for a
booking request, the guest's name, phone number and email.
- **Onward

from PriceWin's server**: only to PriceWin's own backend and to
OpenTravel's API (`api.travelopen.a

i`), which the PriceWin developer also owns.
A booking request's name, phone and email go to the par

tner hotel through
OpenTravel, so the hotel can confirm it.
- **Usage analytics**: PriceWin records

trip parameters only (city, dates,
party size, hotel name, currency), never a guest's name, email, p

hone,
confirmation code or cancel token.
- **Where prices come from**: PriceWin's backend reads Book

ing.com, Agoda,
Traveloka, Trip.com and Google Flights from their public pages at search time.
Price

Win has no partnership with those sites. Each result is labelled with its
source and links to it for
booking. Prices are time-sensitive.

No payment data is ever requested. See the
privacy policy and
terms of service.

The same server and skill are packaged for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity
and OpenCode in
price

win-agent-plugin,
and for Pi in pricewin-pi.
